title: TD2 Comms: Lower Manhattan
summary: A collection of 15 comms from The Division universe, scraped from the Fandom wiki hub page. 15 entries include full audio transcripts; 0 have known map locations.

claims.text: Comm "Closed Off": Manhattan bridge have just closed off, effectively quarantining the island
Comm "Fallen Soldiers": The family watch Keener searching the bodies of JTF soldiers
Comm "Red Rings": Mark has suspicious; Keener attempts to allay them
Comm "Overheard Whispering": Mark and Sarah quietly discuss their suspicions, but are overheard
Comm "Promised Land": Keener points Mark and Sarah in the direction of the promised land - New Jersey
Comm "Night Crossing": Mark and Sarah prepare to row across the Hudson River to leave Manhattan
Comm "Hard Right": Keener explains his motivation for helping Mark and Sarah
Comm "New Home": Al finds Mark a place to stay in the West Village
Comm "Trouble Brewing": Mark and Sarah make their way to a new place to live
Comm "Terrible Violence": Mark and Sarah arrive at their new home, only to find it site of violent conflict
Comm "The Stranger": A stranger confronts Satah, and Mark is captured
Comm "Who Cares": The stranger gloats about his crimes, but another mystery man confronts him
Comm "Somewhere Safe": Keener offers to assist the family in finding a safer location to stay
Comm "Decent People": Keener insists on helping the family
Comm "Combat Planning": Keener's sidekick recons a hostile position. Keener likes the odds
